visual_action: A cutout image of J.B. Pritzker in a suit with his arms raised is superimposed over two different backgrounds. The first is a view of the Chicago River dyed bright green, with a tour boat and city skyscrapers. The second background is the Cloud Gate sculpture, also known as 'The Bean,' in Chicago. Sparkle effects appear on screen.

cast.name: J B Pritzker
